description: This file defines the Migration class responsible for performing database schema updates and data transformations for version 5.3.0 of the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for updating language strings, modifying database tables related to a social feature called Buzz, converting timestamps to UTC, and handling foreign key constraints.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Handles database and data updates specific to migration version 5.3.0, including schema modifications, data transformations, and foreign key management.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration steps to update the database schema and data to version 5.3.0.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the migration, which is '5.3.0'.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns an instance of LangStringHelper for managing language strings.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the version field for language strings in the database.

methods.name: createColumnToStoreBuzzOriginalVideoLink
methods.description: Adds a new column 'original_link' to the 'ohrm_buzz_link' table and populates it based on existing data.

methods.name: modifyBuzzTables
methods.description: Modifies various 'buzz' related tables: drops old tables and columns, alters charset, manages foreign keys, and adds/updates columns to conform to new schema requirements.

methods.name: getConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Retrieves foreign key constraints that conflict with the desired schema, specifically those referencing 'hs_hr_employee'.

methods.name: removeConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Drops conflicting foreign key constraints identified in the schema.

methods.name: recreateRemovedForeignKeys
methods.description: Re-adds foreign key constraints that were temporarily removed to resolve conflicts.

methods.name: changeBuzzTablesDateTimeColumnsAsNotNull
methods.description: Alters specific DateTime columns in buzz tables to be NOT NULL.

methods.name: convertBuzzCommentTableTimesToUTC
methods.description: Converts 'comment_time' and 'updated_at' timestamps in 'ohrm_buzz_comment' table to UTC.

methods.name: convertBuzzPostTableTimesToUTC
methods.description: Converts 'post_time' and 'updated_at' timestamps in 'ohrm_buzz_post' table to UTC.

methods.name: convertBuzzShareTableTimesToUTC
methods.description: Converts 'share_time' and 'updated_at' timestamps in 'ohrm_buzz_share' table to UTC.

methods.name: getTableRecordCount
methods.description: Retrieves the total number of records in a specified table.

methods.name: convertServerTimeToUTCTime
methods.description: Converts a given DateTime object to UTC timezone.

methods.name: getUTCTimeZone
methods.description: Returns the DateTimeZone object for UTC, initializing it if necessary.
